title: At the pharmacy in English: 8 phrases, a real conversation and speaking practice | English Routine
description:
At the pharmacy — في الصيدلية
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:41 The conversation
1:12 3 questions
1:38 Your turn: speak
2:23 Good to know

Words
• something for… = حاجة لـ…
• painkiller = مسكّن
• side effects = آثار جانبية
• drowsy = نعسان / مدروخ
• on an empty stomach = على الريق / على معدة فاضية
• tablet = قرص
• allergic to = عنده حساسية من
• over the counter = من غير روشتة

Practice this situation in the app (it plays the other person and shows you what to fix), one of 665 real-life situations, A1 to C2:
